args.title: Return line
args.goal: Printed receipts include the exact return line after the total line.
args.scope: Append the exact line "Returns within 14 days with receipt." after the total line in src/receipt.mjs. Keep the test named "includes the total" passing in src/receipt.test.mjs. Do not add a module. Email receipts and a PDF renderer are out of scope.
acceptance: renderReceipt appends the exact line "Returns within 14 days with receipt." after the total line.
The test named "includes the total" still passes.
node --test src/receipt.test.mjs from the delivery repo passes.

args.title: Barcode
args.goal: Printed receipts append a barcode line after the return line.
args.scope: In src/receipt.mjs, append a barcode line after the return line from T2. Do not add a barcode file. Do not change the return copy or the total label. Email receipts and a PDF renderer are out of scope.
acceptance: renderReceipt appends a barcode line after the return line "Returns within 14 days with receipt.".

args.title: Total label
args.goal: The total line label reads Amount due:.
args.scope: Change the total line label from Total: to Amount due: in src/receipt.mjs, and update the test named "includes the total" in src/receipt.test.mjs, which currently expects Total:. Do not wait on the return line or the barcode. Email receipts and a PDF renderer are out of scope.
acceptance: renderReceipt prints Amount due: in place of Total:.
The test named "includes the total" expects Amount due: and node --test src/receipt.test.mjs from the delivery repo passes.
